title: OFFSET finds the current row in the filter context: the previous year's amount in a measure grouped by year
query: "Prev", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], OFFSET ( -1, ALL ( 'Date'[Year] ), ORDERBY ( 'Date'[Year], ASC ) ) )

source.quote: Using ALL to ignore the previous filters on year produces the correct result
source.supports: the article's Prev Year Sales measure, CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], OFFSET ( -1, ALL ( 'Date'[Year] ), ORDERBY ( 'Date'[Year], ASC ) ) ), grouped by year gives the previous year's sales

source.quote: If a model column is not matched with any row context, then the VALUES of the column are evaluated in the current filter context
source.supports: the current year comes from the filter SUMMARIZECOLUMNS puts on the year

derivation: Amount by year of OrderDate: 2023 = 210, 2024 = 330. For 2024 the previous year is 2023: 210. 2023 has no previous year: OFFSET returns an empty table, which as a CALCULATE filter leaves no rows, so the amount is BLANK, and SUMMARIZECOLUMNS leaves out the 2023 row, whose only value is BLANK.
